mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO consolidation_hot (device_id, collect_time, seq, pressure, flow_in, flow_out, density, temperature, type, create_ts) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{collectTime}, #{seq}, #{pressure}, #{flowIn}, #{flowOut}, #{density}, #{temperature}, #{type}, #{createTs})
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, collect_time, seq, pressure, flow_in, flow_out, density, temperature, type, create_ts FROM consolidation_hot WHERE collect_time >= #{start} AND collect_time <= #{end} ORDER BY collect_time DESC
SELECT id, device_id, collect_time, seq, pressure, flow_in, flow_out, density, temperature, type, create_ts FROM consolidation_hot WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, device_id, collect_time, seq, pressure, flow_in, flow_out, density, temperature, type, create_ts FROM consolidation_cold WHERE collect_time >= #{start} AND collect_time <= #{end} ORDER BY collect_time DESC
